info.title: CRM Contract Email
info.description: Emails a contract to its customer with the PDF attached, and marks it SENT. The backend sends through Mailjet; the PDF never passes through SAP. Call once the contract status is GENERATED. Replace the server URL with your backend's public URL, and create a BTP destination for it that sends the CRM bearer token.

post.description: Returns status SENT, or ALREADY_SENT when a retry found the contract already emailed and nothing was sent twice.

recipientEmail.description: Optional. Send somewhere other than the contract's contact.

recipientName.description: Optional. Overrides the contact's name in the greeting.

resend.description: Optional. Email again even if already emailed.

404.description: Contract not found in your organization

409.description: No PDF, or the contract is still generating or no longer current

502.description: Mailjet refused the message; reason in the audit log

503.description: Mailjet is not configured on the server
